name: Indonesia
llmPromptRules: - For Indonesian Rupiah (IDR / Rp), dots or commas followed by 3 digits (e.g. "Rp36.500" or "IDR 24,500.00") are thousand separators, so return the full integer "36500" or "24500", never "36.50" or "24.50".
- Indonesian timezone abbreviations map to fixed offsets: "WIB" -> "+07:00", "WITA" -> "+08:00", "WIT" -> "+09:00".
- Common local payment methods and wallets include "GoPay", "OVO Cash", "ShopeePay", "DANA", and "QRIS".
